subject: general
question: Which of the following pre-historic sites provides archaeological evidence of cattle rearing in the form of hoof-marks on clay surfaces?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Mahagara**__. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Mahagara **is located in **Uttar Pradesh** is a pre-historic site having evidence of cattle rearing in the form of **hoof marks**.
 
• Some traces of** the cultivation of rice** have also been found here.
 
• It is situated within the **Belan Valley**.
 
• It is also a** Neolithic site**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Koldihwa **is a **Neolithic site** in **Uttar Pradesh **situated in the valleys of **Belan River** which has remains of** pottery** and** Rice** found from** 7000 BCE.**
 
• **Gufkral **is a** Neolithic site** which is found at **Banmir village in Hurdumir** in **Srinagar**.The** cave of Gufkral** is one in all the** oldest cave** in Kashmir and is believed to be of **2000-3000 BCE.**
 
• **Mehrgarh** is a **Neolithic archaeological site **which is located on the Kacchi Plain of** Balochistan in Pakistan.**
